policy.resolution_rule: A public-consultation notice and its elapsed comment deadline do not establish a final launch, an OPEN submission state, a submission deadline or any final-guide material fact. Every material class remains UNKNOWN until the final package is retrieved, hash-pinned and semantically reviewed together with an explicit current submission window or authoritative cancellation notice.

evidence.source_owner: Organismul Intermediar Regional pentru Programul Educație și Ocupare — Regiunea Nord-Vest
evidence.semantic_assertion: The official OIR notice identifies STEP-VET as a competitive PEO call under Priority P12, Specific Objective ESO4.1 and Action 12.a.1, and accepts consultation comments through 2026-08-03. It is explicitly a public-consultation notice, not a final launch or submission-window notice, so it proves none of the seven publishable material fact classes.
